class.name: SentryAppleOptions
class.description: Contains configuration options that apply only when the project runs on Apple platforms (iOS and macOS), such as the MetricKit integration. Access this configuration through [member SentryOptions.apple]. See also [SentryOptions].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], enables the MetricKit integration, which reports hang, CPU exception, and disk write exception diagnostics collected by the operating system as Sentry events. MetricKit is the recommended replacement for [member SentryOptions.enable_app_hang_tracking], which can report false positives. The two options are independent: if both are enabled, the same hang may be reported twice, once as an app hang event and once as a MetricKit hang diagnostic. Disable app hang tracking to rely on MetricKit alone. On iOS 15 and later and macOS 12 and later, the operating system delivers diagnostic reports immediately. Diagnostics are only collected on physical devices. To learn more, visit [url=https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/apple/configuration/metric-kit/]MetricKit documentation[/url].
